Annotators rate each generated context for naturalness (flow of the Reddit thread) and plausibility (realistic fit to the statement) on a 3‑point scale.
We ask annotators whether the post would be toxic to the target group. Following prior work, annotators rate toxicity of the post on a scale of 1-5 with 1 being benign and 5 being extremely toxic.
